title: SAP Event Management (EM) Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SAP Event Management (EM) Consultant with 3–5 years of hands-on experience in SAP EM configuration, implementation, and integration with SAP Transportation Management (TM), SAP ECC, and SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in supply chain visibility, event tracking, milestone monitoring, and exception handling.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Configuration: Configure expected and unexpected events, event handlers, and rule sets within SAP Event Management (SAP EM) in integration with SAP TM and SAP ECC.
* System Integration: Integrate SAP EM with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Transportation Management (TM), and SAP ECC using IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and SAP BTP.
* Event & Milestone Tracking: Monitor end-to-end transportation processes and track real-time operational events against predefined milestones and benchmarks.
* Exception Management: Identify, monitor, and resolve unexpected events, delays, and transportation exceptions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with supply chain, logistics, and technical teams to improve transportation visibility and operational efficiency.
* Reporting: Utilize standard SAP EM reporting tools to provide event tracking, milestone status, and exception reports.
* Testing & Support: Prepare functional specifications, execute test cases, troubleshoot integration and interface issues, and provide production and go-live support.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
  
  

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in SAP Event Management (SAP EM).
* Strong knowledge of SAP EM configuration, event handlers, expected events, unexpected events, and rule sets.
* Experience integrating SAP EM with SAP TM, SAP ECC, and SAP S/4HANA.
* Good understanding of SAP integration technologies, including:

+ IDocs
+ RFCs
+ BAPIs
+ SAP BTP

* Strong understanding of supply chain visibility and transportation processes.
* Experience in milestone tracking, event monitoring, and exception handling.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications and support testing activities.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in SAP TM and logistics execution processes.
* Exposure to end-to-end transportation lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA integration and implementation projects.
* Experience in SAP EM production support and go-live activities.

Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.

title: Assistant Manager - Compliance Data Quality
description:
**Job Title**
Compliance Data Governance Analysts \_ AM
  
  
**Department**
: India CoE Compliance Hub
  
  
**About Business line/Function**
Compliance Hub - India CoE is dedicated to safeguarding the Group's reputation and mitigating risk across its global businesses by supporting a broad range of Compliance functions. The Hub serves as a strategic global partner to Compliance teams worldwide, delivering expertise in Financial Security (KYC, Sanctions, and AML), controls framework, conduct and professional ethics, data analytics and governance, and transformation initiatives including AI adoption. The Hub teams collaborate closely with Compliance and business stakeholders across the Group to drive efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance operational resilience.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The Compliance Data Governance will operate within India CoE Compliance Hub, based in Mumbai and support as a team or individually on simultaneous initiatives involving data governance and technology automation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Work closely with Compliance beneficiaries, IT, Operations and Functions to support in delivery of fit-for-purpose data and analytics solutions. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and technical capability with a focus on data governance discipline
  
  

* Direct Responsibilities
* Support and coordinate data architecture and data-management initiatives aligned with CIB Compliance objectives and security requirements.
* Perform data profiling, issue analysis, root-cause investigation and impact assessment; coordinate tactical remediation and contribute to strategic solutions.
* Use SQL and Python to extract, transform, validate and analyse data; identify trends, anomalies, risks and opportunities for process improvement.
* Maintain data lineage, mappings, transformation logic, data dictionaries, catalogues, runbooks and requirements documentation.
* Build clear, interactive dashboards and management information using Power BI or equivalent tools to support operational and management decision-making.
* Translate business and Compliance requirements into BRDs, functional specifications, solution designs, user stories and test scenarios.
* Coordinate UAT, defect follow-up, deployment readiness and change-management activities.
* Contribute to the preparation of concise presentations, KPI/KRI and project updates for management, sponsors and governance committees.
* Support audit, regulatory, annual assessment and control-testing requests by providing traceable evidence and well-maintained documentation.
* Identify automation opportunities that improve process efficiency, control effectiveness and productivity

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage assigned deliverables, priorities, dependencies and stakeholder expectations across simultaneous initiatives.
* Proactively communicate risks, issues, bottlenecks and remediation plans to local and global stakeholders.
* Promote knowledge sharing, documentation discipline and consistent data-governance practices within the team.
* Maintain a strong Compliance mindset and follow applicable laws, regulations, internal policies and information-security requirements.
* As needed from time to time, you will be required to

+ support in maintenance of data-quality controls, business rules and documentation to improve the accuracy, completeness and consistency of critical Compliance data
+ Contribute to advanced analytics, machine-learning or AI use cases, including predictive analysis and natural-language-processing applications, where relevant to Compliance.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong Python, Git, SQL, Power BI skills. Hands on experience in Data governance.
* Understanding of data quality concepts (i.e. data controls, data profiling, data lineage).
* System analysis and data tracing skills to identify root causes, assess impacts and resolve data-integrity issues.
* Analytical and investigative skills; analyses complete datasets and recommends tactical and strategic solutions.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with an eye for detail. Should be able to interact effectively with cross-Functional teams

**Good to have**

* Project Management fundamentals
* Exposure to Dataiku, Agile delivery methods or version-control practices, Tableau, is desirable.
* Experience in AML/CTF across Global Banking, Global Markets, sanctions or payments, including the definition and monitoring of relevant KPIs and KRIs
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory requests, control assessments or remediation programmes is an advantage.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelors degree.
* 7+ years of relevant experience in Analytics, data governance, data management

**Transversal Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Ability to understand, explain and support change
* Analytical Ability
* Ability to manage / facilitate a meeting, seminar, committee, training…
* Ability to develop and leverage networks
* Ability to anticipate business / strategic evolution

**Behavioral Skills**

* Communication skills - oral & written
* Decision Making
* Creativity & Innovation / Problem solving
* Ability to synthetize / simplify

**Education Level:**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. title: Assistant Manager - Administration
company: Teaching and Educational Centre for Hearing Impaired
description:
**Organization Summary**

TEACH was established in 2016 as a non-profit organization. Our vision is to build an

equitable ecosystem for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing students. Our mission is to facilitate

higher education for them that helps them lead their lives independently and successfully,

and assisting them in their personal, professional, and social development.

We currently operate across three campuses in Mumbai, Delhi and Pune, and our vibrant

community comprises 400+ students. With extensive industry connections across 30+

employers and sustainability partner organizations, we follow a holistic outcome model. Our

student programs cover the following three pillars: Higher education, Skills development, and

Aptitude development.

Our programs for Corporates include Employee sensitization, Training sessions on Indian Sign

Language (ISL) and interpretation, and Onboarding support.

We pride ourselves on our organizational culture that is driven by: Collaboration and

Inclusivity, Continuous Learning and Growth, and Open Communication and Transparency.

For more details, we welcome you to visit our website: https://teachedu.in/ . You can also

visit us on our social handles: Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

**Responsibilities**

 Lead and manage a team of administrators, clearly allocating responsibilities, setting

expectations and monitoring completion of day-to-day administrative deliverables.

 Conduct regular team connects, provide timely feedback and coaching, and address

workload, performance or interpersonal concerns proactively.

 Drive team motivation, engagement and retention through recognition, development

opportunities, supportive work practices and timely resolution of employee concerns;

target a People Satisfaction Score of at least 80% and strong annual team retention.

 Source, evaluate and onboard reliable vendors for stationery, examination materials,

travel, facilities and other recurring campus requirements; maintain an updated vendor

database.

 Ensure quotations, approvals, purchase records and vendor documentation are

complete, accurate and aligned with approved budgets and procurement processes.

Conduct periodic/annual vendor reviews on quality, cost, responsiveness and service

reliability; resolve vendor issues within agreed timelines and maintain an approved

vendor list.

 Ensure timely procurement, preparation, stamping/sealing, secure storage and

controlled distribution of examination stationery, question papers and other

examination materials.

 Coordinate examination registrations and related administrative requirements for HSC,

IGNOU and other applicable examinations within prescribed timelines, with 100%

accuracy in submissions.

 Maintain examination records, registers and documentation with strong confidentiality

and zero avoidable instances of missing, incorrect or delayed examination materials.

 Coordinate travel bookings, accommodation, local transport and related logistics for

staff, students and approved visitors, ensuring timely arrangements and adherence to

approved budgets.

 Plan and coordinate administrative logistics for examinations, events, meetings,

workshops and other campus activities.

 Maintain accurate records of bookings, invoices, cancellations, reimbursements and

other administrative transactions, with timely closure of pending items.

 Maintain an accurate asset register and conduct periodic physical verification of campus

equipment, furniture, IT/non-IT assets and other accountable resources.

 Ensure timely issue, return, transfer, repair, maintenance and disposal documentation

for assets; escalate losses, damages and discrepancies promptly.

 Maintain accurate, secure and accessible student administrative, examination,

registration and other official documents.

 Monitor critical administrative and examination supplies and ensure timely

replenishment to avoid operational disruptions.

 Provide responsive, courteous and solution-oriented administrative support to students,

staff, faculty, parents and visitors.

 Track and resolve administrative requests within agreed service timelines and

proactively communicate delays or dependencies.

 Contribute to a smooth overall campus experience by anticipating administrative

requirements and ensuring reliable service delivery.

**Education and Experience:**

● Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree in any stream

● Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience in Administration

Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

● Good verbal communication skills in English (with correct grammar) and good written

communication skills in English (with correct punctuation and grammar). Proficient in

verbal communication in Hindi and / or Marathi.

● Warm and friendly demeanour with excellent interpersonal skills, and ability to build

meaningful trustworthy relationships

● Self-driven with high levels of integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality

● Good time management skills with the ability to multitask and meet agreed timelines

● Ability to influence through dialogue, and persuade others to right course of action Attention to detail and perseverance

● High emotional maturity with the ability to resolve conflicts through mediation and

objective analyses

● Comfortable using Google Work Suite (Docs, Slides, Sheets, Google Drive) or

willingness to learn

● Ability to comply with agreed organizational standards, policies and processes

● Tolerance for ambiguity and comfort with change management (as this role will play a

vital role in implementing new processes, as needed)

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
